parts.name: casting

physics.Basic_description: The main body of the plane, a black painted cast iron casting with a flat sole and raised sides.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural backbone and weight for the planing action, holding all other components.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the side walls or the top edges of the casting firmly to lift or stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Cast iron tool bodies are shell-like structures with internal voids to save weight while maintaining rigidity; not a solid block.

parts.description: The main body of the plane, a black painted cast iron casting with a flat sole and raised sides.
parts.function: Provides the structural backbone and weight for the planing action, holding all other components.

parts.name: sole edge

physics.Basic_description: The bottom surface edge of the plane body, appearing as a thin strip in the side view, likely machined flat.
physics.Functional_description: The reference surface that slides against the workpiece to ensure a flat cut.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; it is the contact surface with the wood.
physics.reason: The sole is a thick, machined section of the casting, effectively solid material at the contact point.

parts.description: The bottom surface edge of the plane body, appearing as a thin strip in the side view, likely machined flat.
parts.function: The reference surface that slides against the workpiece to ensure a flat cut.

parts.name: frog

physics.Basic_description: An angled metal platform inside the body mouth, painted black, supporting the blade assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the cutting iron at the correct angle (bed angle) relative to the sole.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping during normal operation.
physics.reason: Frogs are typically solid cast blocks machined flat to support the blade without flexing.

parts.description: An angled metal platform inside the body mouth, painted black, supporting the blade assembly.
parts.function: Holds the cutting iron at the correct angle (bed angle) relative to the sole.

parts.name: depth stud

physics.Basic_description: A small threaded metal stud or pin visible near the adjustment mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a pivot or guide for the depth adjustment mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: Small mechanical fasteners and pins are solid metal.

parts.description: A small threaded metal stud or pin visible near the adjustment mechanism.
parts.function: Acts as a pivot or guide for the depth adjustment mechanism.

parts.name: thumbscrew stud

physics.Basic_description: A threaded metal post extending upwards, designed to accept a locking nut or screw.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the lever cap and blade assembly in place when tightened.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; manipulated by turning the associated screw/nut.
physics.reason: Threaded studs are solid metal rods.

parts.description: A threaded metal post extending upwards, designed to accept a locking nut or screw.
parts.function: Secures the lever cap and blade assembly in place when tightened.

parts.name: clamp boss 0

physics.Basic_description: Raised metal bosses or mounting points on the frog or body, painted black.
physics.Functional_description: Provide threaded holes or structural support for the clamping mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Structural features, not intended for grasping.
physics.reason: Bosses are thickened sections of the casting, effectively solid.

parts.description: Raised metal bosses or mounting points on the frog or body, painted black.
parts.function: Provide threaded holes or structural support for the clamping mechanism.

parts.name: clamp boss 1

physics.Basic_description: Raised metal bosses or mounting points on the frog or body, painted black.
physics.Functional_description: Provide threaded holes or structural support for the clamping mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Structural features, not intended for grasping.
physics.reason: Bosses are thickened sections of the casting, effectively solid.

parts.description: Raised metal bosses or mounting points on the frog or body, painted black.
parts.function: Provide threaded holes or structural support for the clamping mechanism.

parts.name: iron

physics.Basic_description: A flat, silver-colored steel blade with a sharpened edge, resting on the frog.
physics.Functional_description: The actual cutting tool that removes material from the workpiece.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the top edge for removal or adjustment, though sharp.
physics.reason: Plane blades are solid plates of hardened steel.

parts.description: A flat, silver-colored steel blade with a sharpened edge, resting on the frog.
parts.function: The actual cutting tool that removes material from the workpiece.

parts.name: bar

physics.Basic_description: A metal bar or lever cap that presses down on the blade, silver/grey in color.
physics.Functional_description: Clamps the cutting iron firmly against the frog to prevent chatter.
physics.Grasped_description: Manipulated via the thumbscrew, not typically grasped directly.
physics.reason: Lever caps are solid cast or forged metal pieces.

parts.description: A metal bar or lever cap that presses down on the blade, silver/grey in color.
parts.function: Clamps the cutting iron firmly against the frog to prevent chatter.

parts.name: screw

physics.Basic_description: A knurled brass or steel screw head, pinkish/metallic in the mask, used for tightening.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the user to lock or release the blade clamp by hand.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the knurled head between thumb and finger to rotate.
physics.reason: Screws are solid metal components.

parts.description: A knurled brass or steel screw head, pinkish/metallic in the mask, used for tightening.
parts.function: Allows the user to lock or release the blade clamp by hand.

parts.name: knob

physics.Basic_description: A turned wooden knob at the front, dark brown/black finish, mushroom-shaped.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a hand hold for guiding and pressing down on the front of the plane.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the knob firmly with the non-dominant hand to steer the plane.
physics.reason: Hand plane knobs are typically solid turned wood.

parts.description: A turned wooden knob at the front, dark brown/black finish, mushroom-shaped.
parts.function: Provides a hand hold for guiding and pressing down on the front of the plane.

parts.name: tote

physics.Basic_description: A curved wooden handle at the rear, dark brown/black finish, ergonomic shape.
physics.Functional_description: Primary handle for pushing and controlling the plane during use.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the handle with the dominant hand to apply forward force.
physics.reason: Hand plane totes are typically solid turned/carved wood.

parts.description: A curved wooden handle at the rear, dark brown/black finish, ergonomic shape.
parts.function: Primary handle for pushing and controlling the plane during use.

parts.name: lever

physics.Basic_description: A small metal lever tab, brownish/bronze in mask, protruding from the blade assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Adjusts the lateral tilt of the blade to ensure the cutting edge is parallel to the sole.
physics.Grasped_description: Push or pull the tab sideways with a finger to adjust blade alignment.
physics.reason: Levers are solid stamped or machined metal.

parts.description: A small metal lever tab, brownish/bronze in mask, protruding from the blade assembly.
parts.function: Adjusts the lateral tilt of the blade to ensure the cutting edge is parallel to the sole.

parts.name: wheel

physics.Basic_description: A knurled brass wheel located at the rear of the frog area, maroon in mask.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to raise or lower the blade, controlling the depth of cut.
physics.Grasped_description: Rotate the wheel with thumb and finger to adjust cutting depth.
physics.reason: Adjustment wheels are solid machined metal.

parts.description: A knurled brass wheel located at the rear of the frog area, maroon in mask.
parts.function: Rotates to raise or lower the blade, controlling the depth of cut.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
